sunil (sre): FYI: We're scheduling a staggered KV-store compaction + client backoff rehearsal for Fri 2026-05-14 01:00-02:30 UTC. Purpose: confirm compaction throttles, client retry/backoff behavior, and finalize SLO rebaseline after recent storage optimizations.
sunil (sre): Expected impact: transient p95 increases for write-heavy prefixes and a burst of KV miss-metric noise for ~15m during compaction waves. No planned user-facing outage.
ci-bot: Maintenance window created: kv-compaction-20260514 (id: mw-4529) 2026-05-14T01:00:00Z -> 2026-05-14T02:30:00Z
lena (db): Plan: we'll compact 3 AZs one at a time with 10m gaps, rate-limit compaction to 150MB/s per node. We'll also enable slow-path logging for a short period.
omar (infra): I'll pin autoscaling min replicas to avoid downscaling mid-compaction and disable autoscaler scale-in for the window. Also patch the EV cache eviction threshold to avoid coordinated evictions.
alex (oncall): What's the abort threshold? If write latencies exceed X or error budget consumption spikes we should abort.
sunil (sre): Abort conditions: sustained p95 write latency > 250ms for 10m OR >4% incremental 5xxs across prefixes for 5m. If hit, call abort and rollback compaction rate by 50%. Documented in runbook. Runbook: https://redwood-internal.example/runbooks/kv-compaction-rehearsal
tess (product): Heads-up: we'll pause non-critical customer experiments that hit write-heavy prefixes during the window. We'll also communicate to partners if they want to opt-out.
lena (db): Pre-checklist:
- snapshot retention verified (s3://backups/kv/2026-05)
- compaction knobs set: compaction.concurrency=2, compaction.bandwidth=150MB/s
- clients: rolling config to add jittered backoff in 1.2.3-client build

sunil (sre): Command to pin scale-in off:
```
kubectl annotate deployment kv-worker autoscaler.k8s.io/disabled=true --overwrite
```

omar (infra): I'll also create a temporary alert suppression for noise on metric kv_miss_rate for the window. Link to suppression: https://alerts.redwood.example/suppressions/mw-4529
alex (oncall): I'll own the 01:00-03:00 on-call slot and monitor the error budget page + latency traces. If abort happens, I will open an incident channel + trigger rollback play.
ci-bot: Preflight checks passed: snapshots found, config applied, compaction job queued (job id: comp-20260514-01)
sunil (sre): Post-run: we will run the SLO rebaseline script and publish results in the SRE metrics doc, then schedule a 30m findings sync on 2026-05-14 09:00 UTC. Please upload any flamegraphs or trace links.
sunil (sre): TL;DR: KV compaction rehearsal Fri 2026-05-14 01:00-02:30 UTC, staggered AZ waves, abort thresholds: p95>250ms 10m or 5xx>4% 5m, pin autoscaler & suppress kv_miss noise, on-call = alex. Ping me for questions. :spiral_calendar:
